additional_info.body:
Hello Emre,
All charger are with rollout done and ready for activate the update except for the charger
yNr80H. This one has the mqtt communication broken and we can't establish SSH port with it. Even with the support from R&D we were not able to fix it. It's necessary to flash the cfast on site, you can do it already with the latest FW to save time.
I'm proceeding to close this ticket.
